name: Verb
description:
Verb Personal MCP connects Claude to your own Verb data.

Ask natural-language questions and get answers derived exclusively from your personal dataset:

Email. "What did my lawyer send me this week?" Search and summarize your forwarded inbox by sender, topic, or date.

Finances. "How much did I spend on subscriptions in June?" Query transactions, balances, recurring charges, and income across your connected bank and card accounts.

Browsing & apps. "What were my top sites this month?" Explore your web, network, and VPN activity.

Social. "What did I search on TikTok last week?" Review your uploaded TikTok and Instagram activity.

Your data lives in one place, but until now there was no good way to ask it anything. This connector closes that gap. Each question runs against your data alone, and every answer includes the tables and queries used, so you can verify exactly where it came from. The connector is strictly read-only: it can't modify your data, your sharing preferences, or your account.

Requirements: a Verb account with at least one data source connected (email forwarding, bank account via Plaid, the Verb VPN, or a social data upload).

_published_faq.name: How do I add Verb to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Verb to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://api.verb-data.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: Is Verb MCP ready for ChatGPT and Claude?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 12, 2026, Verb scores 0/100 on Manufact's MCP publishing checklist. The scan does not yet meet ChatGPT publishing checks and does not yet meet Claude publishing checks. Passing these checks does not guarantee marketplace approval.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Verb MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Verb provides these MCP tools: ask_my_data.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Verb?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Verb in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.
Verb requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.

_published_faq.name: Why is Verb failing MCP readiness checks?
